subject.title: [Bug]: Ctrl+C not working in Windows install on foreground

question: Should this issue wait for native Windows npm-global Ctrl+C reproduction before a new repair PR is queued?
rationale: Current source already handles delivered SIGINT, and the closed candidate PR suggests a Windows keypress bridge but did not prove the safest final layer or cleanup behavior.

options.title: Require Windows live repro
options.body: Keep this issue open until a Windows-capable maintainer or reporter validates current main or the latest package in at least one native Windows shell and captures whether SIGINT is delivered.

options.title: Queue a narrow repair after proof
options.body: If live proof confirms Ctrl+C is not delivered to the foreground Node process, queue a focused gateway run-loop or wrapper fix with cleanup coverage and Windows package proof.

options.title: Close only with shipped proof
options.body: Close later only if a merged commit or release demonstrates the native Windows Ctrl+C path exits cleanly.

recommendation.title: Require Windows live repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a Windows-capable maintainer or reporter validates current main or the latest package in at least one native Windows shell and captures whether SIGINT is delivered.

likelyOwner.reason: The gateway run-loop history points most strongly to repeated lifecycle and restart ownership in this area.
